brands.name: Magnificent
brands.description: A minimalist brand identity mark built around a hand-drawn monogram, enclosed within a double circular frame and accented with a trail of scattered dots for a distinctive, artistic finish.

projects.title: Magnificent Brand Identity Logo
projects.description: A monochrome logo combining an expressive handwritten-style monogram with a clean double-ring circular border. The asymmetrical dotted accents add movement and personality while maintaining a simple, elegant black-and-white aesthetic.

brands.name: Vielsie Cakes
brands.description: Recurring collateral for a home bakery — price lists, seasonal flyers, and customer cards — unified under one soft, consistent palette.

projects.alt: Vielsie Cakes December Rush Sales flyer
projects.title: December Rush Sales Flyer
projects.description: A festive, high-contrast promo flyer built around a limited-time discount, using circular product cut-outs and a deep red seasonal palette to create urgency without losing legibility.

projects.alt: Vielsie Cakes original price list design
projects.title: Price List, Original Version
projects.description: A clean, categorized price list covering cake parfaits, cupcakes, and foil cakes — organized so customers can scan straight to the size and price they need.

projects.alt: Vielsie Cakes updated price list with product photography
projects.title: Price List, Refreshed Version
projects.description: An updated take on the same price list, adding real product photography and a rotated title treatment to give the piece more visual texture while keeping the pricing easy to scan.

projects.title: Year-End Appreciation Card
projects.description: A torn-paper, editorial-style appreciation note thanking customers for the year, layered over product photography to keep the brand's cakes visually present even in a text-first piece.

projects.alt: Vielsie Cakes branded thank you card with QR code
projects.title: Branded Thank-You Card
projects.description: The order-accompanying thank-you card — logo-led, with a scannable QR code for reordering and every social handle in one place, closing the loop on every purchase.

brands.name: Sixteen Laundry & Dry Cleaning
brands.description: A blue-on-white visual system for a Lagos laundry and dry-cleaning service, built for consistency across social and print.

projects.alt: Sixteen Laundry weekend cleaning tips social post
projects.title: Weekend Cleaning Tips — Social Post
projects.description: A tip-style social post pairing an illustrated washing machine with a simple, readable care tip — designed to sit naturally in a feed while reinforcing the brand's blue-and-white identity.

projects.alt: Sixteen Laundry contact card with QR code
projects.title: Contact & QR Card
projects.description: A branded back-of-receipt or handout card centering the logo, a scannable QR code, and every contact channel a customer might use — built as the system's single source of truth for "how to reach us."
